text:
Sam: Day0 creds & KMS check — kicking off AWS/GCP/Azure listing prep. Need: publisher account emails, cross-account IAM role (AWS), GCP service account, KMS key ACLs, and confirmation on private offer/DPA. Who can pick up which?

Ana: I can take AWS pub side. Need publisher email + offer id. Do we plan private offers for gov tenants or just public?

Marta: Packaging heads-up: AMI naming convention must match product slug; trial SKU flag needs to be in listing metadata. Also, UX team wants icon assets in 512x512 PNG.

Ravi: For AWS cross-account role, recommend trust to publisher account. Policy snippet:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT:root"}}]
}
```
Will need role name and external ID.

LegalOps: EULA + DPA templates shared: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace-eula (attach). For private offers we need signed DPA before activation — flag this on runbook.

DeployBot: staging access granted to ana@redwood.com, marta@redwood.com. KMS grant pending (requested).

Sam: Awesome. Can someone own the onboarding runbook and add step-by-step checks (creds, IAM, KMS, images, legal)? Prefer owner = Marta? @Marta

Marta: I'll own it. I'll create a Notion checklist with timestamps and who/when. Will include commands and verification steps.

Ana: Q: GCP SA roles — do we need full storage admin or just objectAdmin for asset upload?

Ravi: ObjectAdmin + compute.imageUser should be enough. gcloud snippet:
```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts create marketplace-uploader --display-name="Marketplace Uploader"
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding PROJECT_ID --member="serviceAccount:marketplace-uploader@PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/storage.objectAdmin"
```

LegalOps: Also note: for Azure offer, we need MPN ID and publisher profile updated. I'll follow up with the partner contract owner.

Sam: Plan: creds+roles + runbook draft by EOD Thu. If any blocker, ping here. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Reminder: scheduled livepatch window Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC — don't schedule resets during that window.
